author: Linda Bonsell
text: Our system was completely full on a Friday afternoon about 5:00 pm. I called multiple septic companies without being able to speak to anyone, so I left messages. I called Pony Express and spoke to Anthony. He agreed to come out on Saturday morning at 9:00 am. He arrived on time and pumped our tanks. He said our leach field failed and put us in touch with someone who could do the work to fix it. Since then he has been available to help us through the repairs. I highly recommend Pony Express as Anthony is professional, friendly and reasonably priced. Really great service.

author: Yvonne Aguilar
text: Pony express provided excellent services for our septic tank. We were able to reach Anthony on a Sunday and scheduled something for Monday morning. He was there on time and emptied it and cleaned the filter. They are super reliable and I definitely recommend his services.

author: Dwayne Neal
text: First time I called Anthony, my tank was full and it was a weekend. He came out within a few hours and got it done. No hassle, no extra charges, just straight up pricing. Earlier this year we were having leech line problems, the guy he recommended came out quoted the job, returned when he said and finished early. Just as professional and courteous as Anthony. Not only do I highly recommend Anthony and Pony Express, but I wont use anyone else, ever.

author: Joyce.rebecca Wright
text: Anthony came out, inspected and pumped the tank. He was friendly,  courteous and did a great job. I highly recommend Pony Express. This was my first time using them.

author: Micah Vinson
text: Have to give credit where credit is due.  Anthony came out with just 1 day notice and did a excellent service. A cleaning like no other.  Great job!
